<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="22" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(302,11)">
      <rect x="0" y="6" width="18" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="19" y="9" width="1.5" height="4" rx="0.75" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.4"/>
      <rect x="2" y="8" width="13" height="6" rx="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="28" cy="11" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="32" cy="11" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.65"/>
      <circle cx="36" cy="11" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.35"/>
      <line x1="49" y1="7" x2="53" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="53" y1="7" x2="49" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="67" cy="11" r="4.7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <rect x="64" y="6.2" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <g transform="translate(20,60)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="12" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
      <polyline points="14,7 8,12 14,17" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <line x1="8.5" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <text x="20" y="108" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#E4E6EB">Forgot Password ?</text>
    <text x="20" y="138" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Choose a recovery method and we’ll send instructions.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Recovery card 1 selected -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="166" width="350" height="100" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4" fill-opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="166" width="350" height="100" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="36" y="182" width="56" height="56" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <circle cx="64" cy="210" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="57,208 63,214 72,203" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="108" y="198" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">via Email:</text>
    <text x="108" y="222" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#E4E6EB">example@youremail.com</text>
    <text x="108" y="242" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Fastest option • resets in a few minutes</text>
    <g transform="translate(340,198)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="24" height="24" rx="3" fill="#1C1E21" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6.5" fill="#1877F2"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Recovery card 2 unselected -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="278" width="350" height="100" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="20" y="278" width="350" height="100" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="36" y="294" width="56" height="56" rx="6" fill="#2E3135"/>
    <circle cx="64" cy="318" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="59" y="309" width="10" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="61.5" y="312" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <text x="108" y="310" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">via SMS:</text>
    <text x="108" y="334" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#E4E6EB">+62 8421 4512 2531</text>
    <text x="108" y="354" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Useful when email access is unavailable</text>
    <g transform="translate(340,310)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="24" height="24" rx="3" fill="#1C1E21" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Explanation block -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="398" width="350" height="112" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="20" y="398" width="350" height="112" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="424" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#E4E6EB">What happens next</text>
    <text x="36" y="448" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">We’ll send a verification code to the selected</text>
    <text x="36" y="468" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">contact method. Enter the code on the next screen</text>
    <text x="36" y="488" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">to create a new password.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Small help / footer card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="528" width="350" height="74" rx="6" fill="#2E3135"/>
    <rect x="20" y="528" width="350" height="74" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="565" r="16" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="43" y="570" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">?</text>
    <text x="76" y="558" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#E4E6EB">Need help choosing?</text>
    <text x="76" y="579" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Contact support at support@newsflow.app</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom submit area -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="726" width="390" height="118" fill="#1C1E21"/>
    <rect x="0" y="724" width="390" height="4" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.22"/>
    <g transform="translate(20,748)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="350" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="175" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Submit</text>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">By continuing you agree to receive recovery messages.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="844" width="390" height="0" fill="none"/>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#000000" stroke-opacity="0.08"/>
    <g transform="translate(28,780)">
      <rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="10" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <polygon points="0,12 12,2 24,12" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="12" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(104,780)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="18" x2="24" y2="24" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="12" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(178,780)">
      <rect x="2" y="5" width="20" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="12" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(254,780)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="9" y="16" width="6" height="6" rx="2" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="12" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Alerts</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(320,780)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="9" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="5" y="17" width="14" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
